update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.35 - Navigation resilience, resumable sessions, lineage view, more presets
Changes --- - Generation farm auto-navigation now retries with a bounded limit and sends a Discord alert on failure instead of silently spinning - Optional fallback to the previous generation's trainee when the next one can't be found, keeping the multi-run session going - Breeding-plan validation warnings (unknown bundle/preset keys) now show in the editor and as a confirm dialog before bot start - Multi-run sessions resume at the last completed generation after a bot restart, with a "Reset progress" action - New lineage view in the run archive: chains a breeding-plan session's runs into a generation-ordered pedigree - 7 additional built-in breeding-plan presets (Classic Crown 3-gen chain, Triple Tiara, Unity Aoharu, stayer/senior-finale, alt mile-sprint route)
Includes v5.9.34 generation farm auto-navigation.
